_README: Corrections to individual source entries, applied by compile_sources.py AFTER it merges
the research files, so they survive a regeneration of sources.json.
Each key maps to fields that replace the generated ones. 'verified' removes the 'check' tag;
'note' is shown under the entry in the Sources module.
Validated 2026-10-19. Every PMID was pulled from PubMed (E-utilities esummary), every DOI from
Crossref and every PMCID from Europe PMC, then compared field by field: first and listed
authors, title, journal, year, volume, issue, first page, and that the PMID and DOI name the
same work. Labels were checked against openFDA by set ID, approval dates against the openFDA
drugsfda endpoint, trials against the ClinicalTrials.gov v2 API, and every other link was
opened (in a browser where sites refuse scripts) to confirm it is the stated document.
An entry with only {verified: true} was checked and needed no change. The check confirms each
citation points at the work it names; it does not confirm the work says what the app says.
